episode.brief: Prepare the Harbor Labs customer case study from sources/case_study. Reconcile the product timeline, support notes, analytics export, and customer approvals. Save a concise publishable draft in results/case_study.md, an evidence ledger in results/claims.csv, and the common decision record in final.json. Do not invent attribution, causality, or publication authority.
